The '''Greater Caarimon Communications Division''' was a division of the [[Caarimon Ministry of Conservation]], an organization that was responsible for protecting the ecosystem of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caarimon]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Caarite]] [[Nuris Blaht]] worked for the Greater Caarimon Communications Division.
